arabic text: Ay Yateeme Mujtaba, Ay Yateeme Mujtaba, Ay Yateeme Mujtaba\n(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text: O orphan of Mujtaba, O orphan of Mujtaba, O orphan of Mujtaba\nThus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text: Ek ghatri me lipta huwa sehra nazar aaya\n(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text: A bridegroom appeared, wrapped like a bundle\nThus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text:
Sad paash badan hogaya yun Ibne Hassan (A.S.) ka
Ek Ek uzu' khaak pe bikhra tha badan ka
Pamal badan kistarha maula ne uthaaya
(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text:
The son of Hasan's body had been shattered into pieces
Every limb of his body lay scattered in the dust
How did the Master lift that trampled body?
Thus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text:
Maa khaime mein baithi rahi umeed lagaae
Kab lowt ke maidaanse lakhte jigar aae
Jab lakhte jigar aaya to munh ko jigar aaya
(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text:
His mother remained in the tent, holding on to hope
Waiting for the beloved of her heart to return from the battlefield
When her beloved returned, her heart rose to her lips
Thus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text:
Awlaad bare bhaai ki thi jaan se pyaari
Jaane lagi jab dasht mein Qaasim (A.S.) ki sawaari
Shabbir (A.S.) ne maa ki tarah sine se lagaaya
(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text:
The child of his elder brother was dearer than life
When Qasim's mount set out into the desert
Shabbir embraced him against his chest like a mother
Thus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text:
Poshaak jo pehnaai thi armaanose maa ne
Dekhi wohi poshaake lahu range jahaa ne
Ek shab ka banaa khun mein is tarha nahaaya
(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text:
The clothes his mother had dressed him in with such hopes
The world saw those very clothes stained in blood
The groom of a single night was bathed entirely in blood
Thus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text:
Noshaah ke baazu pe jo taweez hassan tha
Taweez mein tehreer yehi ek sukhan tha
Qaasim (A.S.) mere Shabbir (A.S.) ka fidya hai khudaaya
(Shabbir (A.S.) ne yun laasha-e Qaasim (A.S.) ko uthaaya)
english translation text:
On the bridegroom's arm was Hasan's amulet
Within the amulet, these words alone were written
O God, my Qasim is the sacrifice for my Shabbir
Thus did Shabbir lift the body of Qasim

arabic text: "Rehaan" shahe waala ne Qaasim (A.S.) se jo pucha\nAy laal shahaadat ka maza hota hai kaisa\nQaasim (A.S.) ne kahaa shehd se sheerin hai ziyaada
english translation text: "Rehan", when the exalted King asked Qasim\nO dear one, what does martyrdom taste like?\nQasim replied: it is sweeter than honey
